new_today_news.headline: Amarillo City Council adopts 2026 tax rate, discusses water and sewer fees
new_today_news.summary: Amarillo City Council approved an 11% increase in water and sewer fees to fund capital improvements for wastewater treatment facilities. The budget includes an 8% increase for capital improvements and 3% for debt service toward a $60 million loan for the Hollywood Road Wastewater Treatment Facility project.

new_today_news.headline: Sodexo and UK Government partnership saves one million meals from waste
new_today_news.summary: Sodexo and the UK Government have prevented over one million meals from waste over five years through a surplus food redistribution program operating across government and energy sites. The initiative redirects meals to food donation partners rather than disposal.

recent_news.headline: GFL Environmental Inc. Announces Quarterly Dividend
recent_news.summary: GFL Environmental declared a Q3 dividend of US$0.0169 per share for shareholders of record October 14, payable October 30, 2026.

recent_news.headline: 2026 Wastewater Rate Adjustments
recent_news.summary: Dripping Springs approved wastewater rate increases effective September 2026 to address rising infrastructure costs and support a growing community. Residential customers will see approximately $20-30 monthly increases depending on usage, with additional increases anticipated through fiscal year 2032.

backfill_news.headline: Research on Clarifying the Merits of Electrification for Garbage Trucks Through Actual Driving Condition Surveys
backfill_news.summary: Academic research published in July 2026 examines the energy efficiency and viability of electric garbage trucks in urban waste management. The study analyzes driving patterns and conditions, providing evidence for sustainable fleet electrification strategies.
